description: This is a Java integration test class for the ImagesApi, testing image retrieval and deletion for entities like clients and staff within the Apache Fineract project.

classes.name: ImagesApiIntegrationTest
classes.description: Test class for verifying image retrieval and deletion functionalities using the ImagesApi in an integration testing environment.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes WireMock server, config, and test image file before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Stops the WireMock server after each test.

methods.name: testRetrieveClientImage
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a client image and verifies response content and headers.

methods.name: testRetrieveClientImageWithMaxDimensions
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a resized client image with maximum width and height parameters.

methods.name: testRetrieveClientImageWithMaxWidthOnly
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a client image resized with only max width parameter.

methods.name: testDeleteClientImage
methods.description: Tests deletion of a client image.

methods.name: testDeleteStaffImage
methods.description: Tests deletion of a staff image.

methods.name: testRetrieveImageWithPngFormat
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a PNG format image and verifies response content and headers.

methods.name: testMultipleEntityTypes
methods.description: Tests image retrieval for multiple entity types (clients and staff) with different IDs.
